scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/api && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/worker && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@campaign/database && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/api && npm run build --workspace=@campaign/worker && node --test apps/api/dist/schedule.test.js apps/api/dist/clock.test.js apps/worker/dist/whatsapp.test.js && npm run test:polling
scripts.test:polling: tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir outputs/polling-tests apps/web/components/visible-polling.ts apps/web/components/visible-polling.test.ts && node --test outputs/polling-tests/visible-polling.test.js
